entities.name: Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element containing the negotiated extended DRX parameters between UE and network.

entities.name: Requested extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element containing the extended DRX parameters requested by the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Registration request message sent by the UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: UE included Requested extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Condition where the UE has included the Requested extended DRX parameters IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Network supports eDRX and accepts use
entities.description: Condition where the network supports extended DRX and accepts the use of eDRX.

entities.name: Network includes Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Property describing the network behavior of including the Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE when conditions are met.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message can contain the Requested extended DRX parameters IE.
Network inclusion of Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE is guarded by the condition that UE included Requested extended DRX parameters IE.
Network inclusion of Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE is guarded by the condition that network supports eDRX and accepts its use.
When conditions are met, the network establishes the inclusion of Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE.
